question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Early
solution:
The correct answer is "**Beforehand**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Early" means happening or done before the usual or expected time.**(जल्दी)

 
 
• Example: Waking up early in the morning is a good habit.
 
 
 
• **"Beforehand" means in advance, earlier than the time expected or required.**(पहले ही)
 
 
• Example: Knowing about the problems beforehand help us to address the issue.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the word "beforehand" is the synonym of the word "early."
 
• Other synonyms of early include premature, timely, ahead of time, and prompt.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2 (Complex) means consisting of many different and connected parts, difficult to understand.(जटिल)
 
• Option 3 (Late) means happening or arriving after the expected or usual time.(देर)
 
• Option 4 (Tardy) means delayed beyond the expected or usual time.(मंदा)
